name: build-jail-preset
note: The build-jail preset compiled standalone: project READ (not write), its secret + .env floors, strip-all env, and egress curated to the $downloads set (the connect case targets an IP literal, which is outside it). The per-package WRITE grant, the provisioned-interpreter read grant, and the scrubbed lifecycle env are supplied per spawn by the lifecycle interposition (compile_build_jail), not this static preset. The .env cases assert `read-content` (no bytes disclosed) rather than `read` (open refused), because the backends deny a builtin-floor dotenv file in two different shapes and only one fails at open: macOS Seatbelt refuses the path, while Linux mount-masks it present-but-empty so a dotenv reader gets no secret instead of a hard error. Non-disclosure is the property that holds on both, and the relaxed negative control still reads the file's bytes, so the assertion cannot go hollow.
